subject: Follow-up on your FlexiFunnels support call – autoresponder and sender domain
body_text:
Hi Rohan,

Thank you for your time on our call. Leads were coming in from your form, but the autoresponder email was not being sent to them.

What we resolved:
- Following our guidance, you turned on the autoresponder option in your form settings and saved it. A test form filled in from your other email address then delivered the email, and you confirmed it is working correctly now.

What we covered:
- Emails can sometimes go to spam, so verifying your sender domain is a good idea. You can do this in the email domain part of the settings. This is not yet done.

Your next steps:
1. Verify your sender domain in the email domain part of the settings (you said you would do this the morning after our call).

You can rewatch our call here: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-P2-04

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Riya
FlexiFunnels Support
